exposure: Amniocentesis performed at or beyond 24 weeks gestation
cohort: 60 pregnant women (with 61 fetuses) who underwent amniocentesis at or beyond 24 weeks gestation.
finding: Amniocentesis performed at later gestations is a safe and effective tool for prenatal diagnosis, enabling genetic diagnosis and counseling.
mod_finding: Among the 51 pregnancies that continued, 76.47% delivered vaginally and 23.52% by caesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at the time of procedure was 25(4/7) weeks (range 24(1/7)-33(1/7) weeks).
